# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Sami: Sweden 1970 and Nordic cooperation.
# COLDWAR Sweden. Generated by tools/sweden_1970/build_national.py.
COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_deliver_democratic_socialist_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_domestic_settlement_open
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_open
			check_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_choice = 1
			}
			check_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_phase = 4
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_escrow
				value = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_capital
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			# IMPERIA COLD WAR — MD standard: no ownership gate, MD fallback build target below
			check_variable = {
				civilian_factories_manpower_fulfillment > 0.89
			}
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_escrow = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_capital
		}
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — MD fallback build target (preferred state first)
		random_owned_controlled_state = { prioritize = { 33 } 
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			add_building_construction = {
				type = industrial_complex
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_round = 1
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_project_delivered
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_industrial_settlement_delivered
		COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_close_democratic_socialist_effect = yes
		update_money_dirty_variable = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_close_democratic_socialist_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_open
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_training_working
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			treasury_change = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_escrow
		}
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_escrow = 0
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_open
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_domestic_settlement_open
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_local_agreed
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_workers_agreed
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_compromise_paid
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_trained_staff
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_phase = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_counted
			}
			subtract_from_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_active_count = 1
			}
			clamp_variable = {
				var = COLDWAR_SWE_active_count
				min = 0
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_counted
		}
	}
}

		set_variable = {

		}

		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_project_delivered
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_industrial_settlement_delivered
		COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_close_maoist_effect = yes
		update_money_dirty_variable = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_deliver_maoist_3_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_domestic_settlement_open
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_open
			check_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_choice = 3
			}
			check_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_phase = 4
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_escrow
				value = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_capital
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			# IMPERIA COLD WAR — MD standard: no ownership gate, MD fallback build target below
			check_variable = {
				agriculture_district_manpower_fulfillment > 0.89
			}
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_escrow = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_capital
		}
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — MD fallback build target (preferred state first)
		random_owned_controlled_state = { prioritize = { 550 } 
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			add_building_construction = {
				type = agriculture_district
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_round = 1
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_project_delivered
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_industrial_settlement_delivered
		COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_close_maoist_effect = yes
		update_money_dirty_variable = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_close_maoist_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_open
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_training_working
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			treasury_change = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_escrow
		}
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_escrow = 0
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_open
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_domestic_settlement_open
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_local_agreed
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_workers_agreed
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_compromise_paid
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_trained_staff
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_phase = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_counted
			}
			subtract_from_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_active_count = 1
			}
			clamp_variable = {
				var = COLDWAR_SWE_active_count
				min = 0
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_counted
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_SWE_national_settlement_monthly_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_domestic_settlement_open
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_open
			check_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_phase = 2
			}
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_local_autonomy_protected
					check_variable = {
						labour_unions_opinion > 49
					}
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_compromise_paid
					check_variable = {
						labour_unions_opinion > 39
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_local_agreed
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_workers_agreed
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_democratic_socialist_phase = 3
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_domestic_settlement_open
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_independent_communist_open
			check_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_independent_communist_phase = 2
			}
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_local_autonomy_protected

				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_independent_communist_compromise_paid
					check_variable = {
						labour_unions_opinion > 39
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_independent_communist_local_agreed
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_independent_communist_workers_agreed
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_independent_communist_phase = 3
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_domestic_settlement_open
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_moscow_communist_open
			check_variable = {

			}
			OR = {

					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_local_autonomy_protected
					check_variable = {

					}
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_moscow_communist_compromise_paid
					check_variable = {

					}
				}
			}

		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_moscow_communist_local_agreed
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_moscow_communist_workers_agreed
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_moscow_communist_phase = 3
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_domestic_settlement_open
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_settlement_maoist_open
			check_variable = {
